title: Bench 00 / board check: bare DevKit, GPIO1 to GND for the ADC ground check
notes: One DevKit, nothing else connected. The single jumper is only for the ADC reference app's ground check (simulation/simantic/hardware-validation/esp32s3-adc); remove it before bench 01. GPIO1 is an ADC input there and is never driven, so tying it to GND is safe.

connections.label: GPIO1 -> GND, ADC ground check only
